Ground filming permit within the country
رخصة التصوير الأرضي داخل دولة الإمارات العربية المتحدة

sections.heading: Use only after verifying the service
sections.en: These published conditions concern the ground-filming permit service. Match the actual application service before citing them; a shared Licensing page alone is insufficient. This source describes the published service, not the recorded reasons for an individual decision.

sections.heading: Published materials and conditions
sections.en: The NMA service page lists digital identity, a passport, a portrait, applicant data and the completed permit request. It calls for submission at least 15 working days before filming, specifying its purpose, dates and exact locations. It also requires media-content compliance, payment, coordination with the relevant authorities after permit issuance, and observance of filming restrictions. The process is online submission followed by review and, upon approval, payment. Source: https://www.nma.gov.ae/en/services/ground-filming-permit-within-the-country
sections.ar: تذكر صفحة الهيئة الهوية الرقمية وجواز السفر وصورة الشخص وبياناته وطلب التصريح. وتشترط التقديم قبل التصوير بخمسة عشر يوم عمل على الأقل، وبيان الغرض والمواعيد والمواقع بدقة، والالتزام بمعايير المحتوى وسداد الرسوم واستكمال إجراءات الجهات المعنية بعد التصريح ومراعاة الأماكن المحظورة. يتم التقديم إلكترونياً ثم المراجعة والدفع عند الموافقة. المصدر: https://www.nma.gov.ae/ar/services/تصريح-تصوير-أرضي-داخل-الدولة

sections.heading: Version, decision and missing-document limits
sections.en: The two official pages were inspected on 28 September 2026. Neither supplies an edition, effective date or article number. This observation date is not an effective date. Do not infer which version decided a historical submission. For a particular application, verify its stored form, uploads, conditional requiredness, service configuration and decision history separately; this general requirements list alone cannot prove an attachment is missing or that a decision was correct.
